newsitem.title: USA: Turner Group completes Auburn merger.
newsitem.headline: Turner Group completes Auburn merger.

text.p: Turner Group Inc said on Wednesday that it had completed a reverse-merger with the publicly traded Auburn Equities Inc to become a publicly owned company.

"As a public company we will have access to the public capital markets to finance our planned future growth and with the ability to make acquisitions with stock, our corporate growth potential is greatly enhanced," said W. Thomas Turner, president of Turner Group.
The environmental consulting and engineering company said its common stock is now trading on the NASD Over-The-Counter Bulletin Board under the trading symbol.
